# The Imperial Coalition (TIC)
[color=#999999][italic]"Nothing will stand in the way of the Coalition, that is certain, especially not those 'TDF' or 'Solarians'."[/italic][/color] [color=#999999][italic]- Lieutenant Commander Lights-The-Torch, TIC Space Navy[/italic][/color]
The Imperial Coalition is the original government of the Triad sector and a number of other sectors, until they lost control of the Triad sector in 2823. Governing with an iron fist, the Coalition is defined by a rigid code of honor where disputes are settled by the blade. To ensure the sector's total submission, they maintain a chilling silence by making every dissonant voice disappear. The Imperial Coalition is a government that heavily focuses on military might and advancement, hence why you may find scattered research and ruins in the area with left behind tech on abandoned stations or brass asteroids. They have a number of companies under their name, serving the Coalition through material acquisition, weapons manufacturing, or even research of new technology, though their techniques are out-of-date and usually technologically outclassed by the [textlink="SD" link="SolarianDirective"] or [textlink="TDF" link="TriadDefenseForce"], but that does not make them any less of a force to be reckoned with.
They currently are in a cold-war with the nearby [textlink="Solarian Directive" link="SolarianDirective"], the Coalition waiting for the perfect moment to strike the [textlink="SD" link="SolarianDirective"], then the [textlink="TDF" link="TriadDefenseForce"], then to finally bring the Triad sector back into the Coalition's hands.
